## The config {#lc-datagen-short data-autoslide="2500"}

::: {}

- [Sentinel-2 L2A: 4 scenes / year\*]{cfg="s2l2a"}
- [Landsat Collection 2: 4 scenes / year\*]{cfg="lc2l2"}
- [DEM: 1 annual scene]{cfg="dem"}
